sourcePolicy: The kit ships the 4 px spacing scale (--space-1 through --space-8 in theme.css, no --space-7) but no page-grid system; these are the contract's layout constraints for composing it.
thirdsPolicy: Allowed only for parallel KPI cards with identical anatomy.
alignmentRules: Title, toolbar, main content and footer share one content inset.
Repeated components share header, value, support and action baselines.
One parent owns each divider and boundary.
Selection does not change component geometry.
Numeric comparison columns use tabular numerals and consistent alignment.
responsiveOrder: Convert inspector to layer or route
Preserve primary job, action, readable type and target size
acceptance: No ordinary horizontal page overflow at 320 CSS px.
Visual, DOM, reading and keyboard order agree.
Primary action remains named and reachable.
Overlays remain within the viewport and do not obscure focus.
Long content wraps, truncates with disclosure, or uses a justified local scroll region.
